units.source_text: 对于这种不合理性，我是无法接受的。

en.t: I could not accept this kind of irrationality.

units.source_text: 事实上，我的欲望愈发强烈了。

en.t: In fact, my desire grew stronger and stronger.

units.source_text: 但这种欲望并不是希望她与我结合。

en.t: But this desire was not a wish for her to be joined with me.

units.source_text: 假使她不爱别人而只爱我，那么就必须有将我从别人区别开来的个别因素。

en.t: If she loved no one else and loved only me, then there had to be some individual factor that set me apart from others.

units.source_text: 这不是别的，正是我生就的一双X型的腿。

en.t: That was nothing other than the pair of X-shaped legs I had been born with.

units.source_text: 尽管她嘴里没说出来，但她是爱着我的X型的腿的。

en.t: Although she never said it aloud, what she loved was my X-shaped legs.

units.source_text: 这种爱在我的思考里是不可能的。

en.t: In my way of thinking, that kind of love was impossible.

units.source_text: 如果说，我的个别性不是X型的腿，而是其他，也许爱是可能的。

en.t: If my individuality had not been my X-shaped legs but something else, perhaps love might have been possible.

units.source_text: 然而，倘使我承认X型的腿以外的我的个别性和我的存在理由，那么，我就得补充地承认这种东西。

en.t: However, if I acknowledged an individuality and a reason for my existence apart from my X-shaped legs, then I would also have to acknowledge such things as supplements.

units.source_text: 相应也得相互补充地承认他人的存在理由，进而承认被包围在世界之中的自己。

en.t: Correspondingly, I would also have to acknowledge, in mutual supplement, the reason for other people's existence, and further acknowledge myself as someone enclosed within the world.

units.source_text: 她以为她是爱着我，这也是一种错觉，我是不可能爱她的。

en.t: She thought she loved me, but that too was an illusion; it was impossible for me to love her.

units.source_text: 因此，我反复地说："我不爱你。"

en.t: Therefore, I said again and again, "I do not love you."
